  Scenario: AC8 Every business rule of section 8 has a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules table of section 8
    When each rule BR1 to BR9 is read with its Covered by cell
    Then each rule names at least one criterion and one test case of section 16
    Then BR8 names AC8, and a rule that is an architecture constraint names its guardrail or boundary test where no criterion applies

  Scenario: AC9 An error answer 401, 403 or 404 of a provided operation is defined and a stub answer the contract does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the provided operations of the contract document
    When the error answers with status 401, 403 and 404 are validated against it
    Then each of the three answers names its status code and its body is the one the contract defines
    Then a stub answer with a status code or body the contract does not allow fails the contract test
